narrative: 掌控、仪式、喜剧和命运都偏爱这种构图方式。人物不需要向某个三分点借用空间。
整个房间都在向他汇报，或者假装如此。谁拥有这个空间，早已由建筑本身预先决定。
它不适合用于偷听、追逐，以及大多数需要视线朝外的对话场景。如果画面两侧充满了不均衡的生活细节，你得到的其实是一张偏移构图配一颗居中的头，这是完全不同的语句。
韦斯·安德森（Wes Anderson）让这种语法广为人知，这正是我们需要精确定义它的原因。形式感才是这项技术的工具本身，
而粉彩色的行李箱不是。
how: 让摄影机正对背墙。让左右两侧的质量匹配，或者让一处刻意设计的失衡成为唯一的笑点。
把镜头保持在布景的中轴线上，而不是随意的手持近似值。27mm到40mm的焦段能展现出房间的服从姿态。
更长的镜头会裁掉这种致敬感，只留下单纯的正中取景（Central Framing）。提示词：Dead-center composition of [Subject], bilateral symmetry or frontal tableau, Wes Anderson formality, the subject as altar.
when: 用它表现一次仪式性的登场、一张权力的办公桌、一出玩偶屋式的喜剧，或一种感觉像是被设计好的命运。不要把它用在一场应当让人感觉是偷窃来的追逐戏或耳语场面上。
vs: 正中取景（Central Framing）只要求身体位于十字准星上。中心构图则要求整个画面场域都参与其中。
对称构图（Symmetry）是更强的主张，要求左右互为镜像。你完全可以在一个并非镜像的房间中让主体居中。
单点透视（One-Point Perspective）在同一条轴线上加入了一个消失点，形成一条隧道，而不是一座平面的祭坛。活人画（Tableau）则把这种布局定格在时间之中。
examples_film: 《布达佩斯大饭店》（The Grand Budapest Hotel）把酒店内部建成正面朝向的祭坛；《月升王国》（Moonrise Kingdom）把帐篷、教堂和孩子们呈现为经过安排的图表。
两部影片都让微小的人性偏差因这条极其干净的轴线而显得格外响亮。这是语法，而不是一套美术设计的行头。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是在一个未经构图设计的房间里居中一个头。破绽是一张靶心式的脸，一侧放着一盆植物，另一侧是一扇门。
修正方法：让摄影机正对，匹配两侧的质量，或者干脆改用正中取景，坦诚地保留那种杂乱。

faq.q: 电影中的中心构图（Centered Composition）是什么？
faq.a: 主导性的主体位于中轴线上，画面的其余部分都围绕这条轴线组织。画面变成一幅正面朝向的活人画。人物就是祭坛。剩余的空间不属于任何视线朝外的意图。

faq.q: 中心构图（Centered Composition）与对称构图（Symmetry）有何区别？
faq.a: 中心构图把主体放在轴线上。对称构图则让质量在这条轴线两侧互为镜像。一张歪斜办公室里居中摆放的办公桌是居中的，但并不对称。一条无人居中的镜像走廊是对称的，但没有一个居中的主角。

faq.q: 什么时候该用中心构图（Centered Composition）？
faq.a: 用它表现掌控、仪式、喜剧或命运：一个被顺从的房间所呈现出来的人物。不要在角色应当在空间中搜寻，或应当隐藏在别人的构图之中时使用它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写中心构图（Centered Composition）的提示词？
faq.a: 要求明确轴线和整个房间的配合。示例：Dead-center composition of [Subject], bilateral symmetry or frontal tableau, Wes Anderson formality, the subject as altar。说明摄影机正对背墙。如果你只写“居中的脸”，得到的只会是三分法式的构图。

narrative: Control, ritual, comedy, and fate all like this diagram. The person does not borrow space from a third.
The room reports to them, or pretends to. Who owns space is settled in advance by the architecture.

It is the wrong tool for eavesdropping, pursuit, and most dialogue that needs a look-off. If the sides are busy with unequal life, you have an offset picture with a centered head, which is a different sentence.
Wes Anderson made the grammar famous, which is a reason to be precise. Formality is the instrument.
how: Square the camera to the back wall. Match left and right masses, or let a planned mismatch be the only joke.
Keep the lens on the centerline of the set, not a casual handheld approximation. A 27mm to 40mm will show the room's obedience.

Longer glass will crop the salute and leave you with mere central framing. Prompt: Dead-center composition of [Subject], bilateral symmetry or frontal tableau, Wes Anderson formality, the subject as altar.
when: Use it for a ritual entrance, a desk of power, a dollhouse comedy, or a fate that feels designed. Do not use it on a chase or a whispered aside that should feel stolen.
vs: Central Framing only demands the body on the crosshairs. Centered composition demands the field.
Symmetry is the stronger claim that left mirrors right. You can center a subject in a room that is not a mirror.
One-Point Perspective adds a vanishing point on the same axis, a tunnel instead of a flat altar. Tableau holds the arrangement in time.
examples_film: The Grand Budapest Hotel builds hotel interiors as frontal altars. Moonrise Kingdom presents tents, churches, and children as arranged diagrams.
Both films let a small human deviation read loudly because the axis was so clean. Grammar, not a production-design costume.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a centered head in an uncomposed room. The tell is a bullseye face with a plant on one side and a door on the other.
The fix is to square the camera, match the masses, or switch to Central Framing and let the mess be honest.

faq.q: What is centered composition in film?
faq.a: The dominant subject sits on the central axis, and the rest of the picture is organized around that axis. The frame becomes a frontal tableau. The person is an altar. Leftover space does not belong to a look-off.

Centered composition puts the subject on the axis. Symmetry mirrors masses across that axis. A centered desk in a lopsided office is centered without being symmetrical. A mirrored hall with nobody in the middle is symmetrical without a centered hero.

faq.q: When should I use centered composition?
faq.a: Use it for control, ritual, comedy, or fate: someone presented by a room that obeys. Do not use it when the character should be hunting through space or hiding in someone else's diagram.

faq.q: How do I prompt centered composition for AI image or video?
faq.a: Demand the axis and the room. Example: Dead-center composition of [Subject], bilateral symmetry or frontal tableau, Wes Anderson formality, the subject as altar. Say camera square to the back wall. If you only say centered face, you will get a portrait crop.
